mapper.select: SELECT line_id AS lineId, po_id AS poId, po_code AS poCode, order_date AS orderDate, vendor_name AS vendorName, src_item_id AS srcItemId, item_code AS itemCode, item_name AS itemName, brand, spec, unit_code AS unitCode, unit_name AS unitName, item_category AS itemCategory, qty_ordered AS qtyOrdered, qty_received AS qtyReceived FROM stg_pm_po_line ORDER BY po_code, line_id

SELECT i.src_po_line_id AS poLineId, SUM(r.qty) AS qty FROM stg_pm_requisition r JOIN stg_pm_inbound i ON UPPER(i.src_line_id) = UPPER(r.src_line_receipt_id) WHERE i.src_po_line_id IS NOT NULL AND i.src_po_line_id <> '' GROUP BY i.src_po_line_id

SELECT i.src_po_line_id AS poLineId, SUM(ret.qty) AS qty FROM stg_pm_return_in ret JOIN stg_pm_requisition r ON UPPER(r.src_line_id) = UPPER(ret.src_line_receipt_id) JOIN stg_pm_inbound i ON UPPER(i.src_line_id) = UPPER(r.src_line_receipt_id) WHERE i.src_po_line_id IS NOT NULL AND i.src_po_line_id <> '' GROUP BY i.src_po_line_id

SELECT i.src_po_line_id AS poLineId, SUM(ro.qty) AS qty FROM stg_pm_return_out ro JOIN stg_pm_inbound i ON UPPER(i.src_line_id) = UPPER(ro.src_line_receipt_id) WHERE i.src_po_line_id IS NOT NULL AND i.src_po_line_id <> '' GROUP BY i.src_po_line_id

SELECT i.src_line_id AS srcLineId, SUM(r.qty) AS qty FROM stg_pm_requisition r JOIN stg_pm_inbound i ON UPPER(i.src_line_id) = UPPER(r.src_line_receipt_id) WHERE i.src_line_id IS NOT NULL AND i.src_line_id <> '' GROUP BY i.src_line_id

SELECT i.src_line_id AS srcLineId, SUM(ret.qty) AS qty FROM stg_pm_return_in ret JOIN stg_pm_requisition r ON UPPER(r.src_line_id) = UPPER(ret.src_line_receipt_id) JOIN stg_pm_inbound i ON UPPER(i.src_line_id) = UPPER(r.src_line_receipt_id) WHERE i.src_line_id IS NOT NULL AND i.src_line_id <> '' GROUP BY i.src_line_id

SELECT i.src_line_id AS srcLineId, SUM(ro.qty) AS qty FROM stg_pm_return_out ro JOIN stg_pm_inbound i ON UPPER(i.src_line_id) = UPPER(ro.src_line_receipt_id) WHERE i.src_line_id IS NOT NULL AND i.src_line_id <> '' GROUP BY i.src_line_id
SELECT cat_key AS catKey, cat_name AS catName, parent_key AS parentKey FROM stg_pm_item_category ORDER BY cat_key
SELECT item_code AS itemCode FROM stg_pm_inbound WHERE item_code IS NOT NULL AND item_code <> '' UNION SELECT item_code AS itemCode FROM stg_pm_po_line WHERE item_code IS NOT NULL AND item_code <> ''
SELECT DISTINCT vendor_id AS vendorId, vendor_name AS vendorName FROM stg_pm_inbound WHERE vendor_id IS NOT NULL AND vendor_id <> ''
SELECT DISTINCT unit_name AS unitName FROM stg_pm_inbound WHERE unit_name IS NOT NULL AND unit_name <> ''
